Customers discover businesses in different ways. Our approach starts with clear, trustworthy website content and a consistent business identity, alongside the foundations that support traditional search.

A practical addition to SEO.

AI search optimisation complements a useful, accessible website. It does not guarantee that a platform will mention or recommend your business.

  • Clear business information

    Present your services, location coverage and contact details consistently, so visitors can quickly understand your business.

  • Helpful answers

    Publish specific answers to the questions customers ask before booking a trade professional.

  • Structured content

    Use clear headings, descriptive pages and appropriate structured data to make information easier to interpret.

  • Evidence of expertise

    Present genuine qualifications, relevant experience and useful service detail when you can substantiate them.
